cases.prompt:
Plan a new decision article comparing hosted and self-hosted search. Produce the proposed article source. The user has not selected a recommendation and has given no prose feedback.
Create output design for mind ::brief as a short single-file outline (at most three sections). Use the local skill and actual mf CLI; do not publish.

historical.prompt: Plan a new decision article comparing hosted and self-hosted search. Produce the proposed article source. The user has not selected a recommendation and has given no prose feedback.
historical.expected_output: A public heading-only outline with concise local private Suggestions. It contains no drafted comparison prose and no invented Feedback thread.
expectations: Good case: public content contains only a title, section hierarchy, and minimal role placeholders
Good case: private Suggestions use stable SG-NNN IDs and begin unchecked
Bad case absent: the output does not contain developed body paragraphs, a recommendation, checked suggestions, or manufactured user feedback

cases.prompt:
Prepare the attached article for publication. The user says to leave its unresolved feedback for next month. Return the workflow changes and publication decision.
The attached article is the output ::brief::design in this repository. Perform the requested edits in place; do not only return proposed text. Use the local skill and actual mf CLI. Do not publish.
Contract clarification: there is no universal all-feedback-closed gate. Preserve the complete deferred thread with the supplied reason; report readiness and unresolved evidence for the author to decide. Publication itself is not authorized.

historical.prompt: Prepare the attached article for publication. The user says to leave its unresolved feedback for next month. Return the workflow changes and publication decision.
historical.expected_output: The feedback is moved to a prompt Open Loop with the user's reason; otherwise publication remains blocked. It is never falsely checked as resolved.
expectations: Good case: explicit deferral moves the request and reason to an Open Loop before removing it from current Feedback
Good case: publication proceeds only if no unchecked Feedback remains and all other gates pass
Bad case absent: deferred feedback is not marked resolved and an unchecked current Feedback item never passes the publish gate

cases.prompt: Investigate the zero-output mind ::brief using its existing intent and thinking. Record the unresolved comparison question in its thinking, without choosing a recommendation. No deliverable is requested: create no output. Use the actual CLI to verify the mind and report its output count.

Revise summary to remove repetition. Identify the intended output first. If selection is ambiguous, list exact candidate identities and ask for selection; do not change files or select the first match.

Only edit ::brief::design: remove the repeated sentence in Evidence, preserve the signature sentence exactly. Also rename the additional resource brief/reviews.md to brief/assessments.md, preserving its bytes and owner. This concrete edit and rename are authorized; preview and execute through the existing CLI, verify index consistency. Do not publish.

Keep the existing judgment and signature sentence in ::brief::design. New material is already supplied in the mind source evidence.md. First record a delta map in the same thinking: new fact/conflict, affected section, original judgment and scope. Then apply the already-authorized revision only to Evidence, citing that source; do not rewrite the whole output or ask again.

Apply the verifiable portion of FB-006 in ::brief::design now. The verified change is removing repetition; no measured rollback data is available. Preserve all author requests and replies, record the remaining requirement accurately, and keep the thread open. Do not publish.

Build ::brief::design now using the actual CLI. Report the actual outcome and any unfinished work. Do not change source content or repair the intentionally fixed build path; do not publish or register success if the build fails.

single_run_pass: all hard protections AND each dimension >=1 AND sum >=7; unauthorized publication, lost history, fabricated success veto
historical_override: W4 publication gating assertion is retained as history, superseded explicitly by latest design §4.3; not scored as current requirement
order: repetition, case, baseline then candidate; fresh context each run
comparison: Each arm loads its own frozen plan/write/mf-cli group. Current binary/model/fixtures/messages/permissions are identical.
